name: Annual RV inspection
summary: A yearly check of the brakes, tires, lights, electrical and plumbing, so you know your RV is safe before you head out.
includes: A call to go through what we found and what needs work
bring: The keys to the unit and any compartment locks
Your last inspection or service paperwork, if you have it

faq.q: How much does an inspection cost?
faq.a: Call the shop for the current price for your unit.

faq.q: What happens if you find a problem?
faq.a: We call you, tell you what we found and quote the repair. You decide what we fix. No extra work without your OK.

faq.q: Can you do an Ontario safety standards certificate?
faq.a: Call us to check for your unit.
